mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DBF_USER (USER_NAME, USER_EMAIL, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES ( #{userName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userEmail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useYn,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, DB_CONFIG_ID, USER_NAME, USER_EMAIL, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM DBF_USER WHERE USE_YN = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE DBF_USER SET DB_CONFIG_ID = NULL , UPDATED_AT = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
